title: Nvidia ships an open agent safety stack with more than 100 partners
summary: Nvidia released the Open Agent Safety Platform, pairing two components with different jobs. OpenShell is an Apache 2.0 runtime that sandboxes agent fleets with kernel-level isolation and enforces a declarative policy over the files, networks, tools and credentials each may reach. Sentry is a monitoring design that runs on BlueField-4 data processing units off the agent's own compute, so it can quarantine a runaway workload in milliseconds. Nvidia says the stack, built with more than 100 organisations including Anthropic and Microsoft, could have stopped this summer's Hugging Face breach.
